holder-quote: This time, though, Ulvama was ready.
effect-quote: The hamster dodged away from her spot, avoiding both the orb of lightning and vine.

holder-quote: The Hobgoblin instantly dropped the packs, raised her thorn-spear, and cast a spell.
effect-quote: A spectral length of plant matter shot into the water, and Ulvama felt it wrap around something.
